notes:
Summary: Oxbrook builds a multitenant support platform used by three large telcos & two banks. They want to cut live agent touches by improving ticket deflection and surfacing precise KB answers in the top-5 results.

Key asks: scale to ~12M indexed artifacts (tickets + KB + transcripts), embeddings + rerank hybrid pipeline, end-to-end 95p latency SLO <= 250ms for retrieval+rerank for their primary region, cost target <= $0.005/query, strong audit logging and EU residency.

From AE call (Maya): 'If we can hit top-5 precision at 92% with E2E p95 under 250ms we can de-risk a rollout to 150k seats.' Emphasis on deterministic latency — spikes are deal-breaker.

Security: must pass SOC2 questionnaire, SSO (Okta), KMS integrations for keys, and option for VPC peering. Legal is pushing for explicit EU data residency for EU customers.

PoC ask: index a 12M doc dump, run 10k query benchmark (mix of short/long queries), measure top-5 recall/precision, measure p50/p95/p99 latency under 200 qps. PoC duration estimated 6 weeks.

tech_summary: Current infra: multitenant Postgres + S3 store, search built on OpenSearch with heuristic reranking. Wants to replace with vector-index + lightweight BM25 prefilter + cross-encoder rerank for top-5. Target index size ~12M vectors (avg dim 1536). Expected query load: 50-200 qps during peak. Priority: deterministic p95 latency, rerank quality for top-5, cost under $0.005/query. Prefers managed offering but open to Dedicated in VPC for predictable throughput.
sla_targets: E2E retrieval+rerank p95 <= 250ms; p99 < 500ms (grace under heavy burst); top-5 precision >= 92% on labeled ticket set; availability 99.9%
evaluation_findings: Initial hosted test: vector retrieval p95 ~140ms (50k shards simulated)
Cross-encoder rerank prototype (distil-cross) adds ~60-80ms per query at batch size=8
End-to-end hosted pipeline prototype p95 ~230ms under baseline query mix
Indexing throughput: 12M docs ingest estimated 48 hours with current bulk-embed pipeline

Week 1-2: baseline retrieval tests (latency, recall) — measure p50/p95/p99

decision_criteria: Must meet top-5 precision >= 92% on labeled set AND E2E p95 <= 250ms under 200 qps; legal sign-off on data residency; total cost per query <= $0.005 (or clear plan to get there)
